name: menu
title: Menu
description: A list of actions under a button, with sections, icons, shortcuts and disabled items that say why.

when: Several actions for one object that don't all fit as buttons.

instead.when: The actions belong to what is under the pointer.
People pick a value, not run an action.
Two or three actions that fit as visible buttons.

guidance.rule: Items are verbs; a disabled item says why.

keyboard.does: Goes to the first or last item.

builtIn: Announced as a menu button and menu.
youProvide: A name for an icon-only menu button.
With children: a textValue on a MenuItem whose label is not plain text, so typing can jump to it; the destructive item last, after a MenuSeparator.
